en: Colorized vintage view of a large hilltop castle complex surrounded by dense green forest in a valley. The main building has white walls, a red-tiled roof, and a tall tower with a clock and dark spire. Smaller houses with red and gray roofs sit below the castle. At the top left, red German text reads "Schloß Weesenstein im Müglitztale". The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century printed postcard.
